_about: Structured-data fixes applied by tools/build-data.mjs to the 5e-database copy of SRD 5.1. Found by checking against the Player's Handbook (data/verify/*.json). Format: file -> index -> { dotted.path: value }. `_why` documents each fix.

flame-blade._why: PHB: 'You can use your action to make a melee spell attack with the fiery blade.'

flame-strike._why: PHB: 10-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder; size is the radius like other cylinders

move-earth._why: PHB: an area of terrain no larger than 40 feet on a side, not a cone

magnificent-mansion._why: PHB: entrance 5 x 10 feet, dwelling up to 50 contiguous 10-foot cubes; not a 5-foot cube

higher_level: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 1st.
heroism._why: PHB has an 'At Higher Levels' entry missing from the database

scorching-ray._why: PHB: Make a ranged spell attack for each ray.

spirit-guardians._why: PHB: Wisdom saving throw, half damage on success

web._why: PHB: Dexterity saving throw or restrained

sleet-storm._why: PHB: Dexterity save or fall prone; Constitution save for concentration

seeming._why: PHB: unwilling creature can make a Charisma saving throw

sanctuary._why: PHB: attacker must make a Wisdom saving throw

power-word-stun._why: PHB: Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns

true-polymorph._why: PHB: unwilling creature makes a Wisdom saving throw

plant-growth._why: PHB: Casting Time: 1 action or 8 hours

higher_level: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you can affect one additional beast for each slot level above 1st.
animal-friendship._why: PHB has an At Higher Levels entry missing from the database

disintegrate._why: PHB: the damage increases by 3d6 for each slot level above 6th

arcane-hand._why: PHB: Clenched Fist — melee spell attack, 4d8 force; +2d8 for each slot level above 5th

call-lightning._why: PHB: Dexterity saving throw, half damage on success

earthquake._why: PHB: Constitution saving throw (concentration, fissures use Dexterity)

detect-thoughts._why: PHB: Wisdom saving throw to probe deeper

druid-7._why: PHB Beast Shapes table: CR 1 only from 8th level

warlock-4._why: PHB Warlock table: 2 invocations at 4th level

warlock-6._why: PHB Warlock table: 3 invocations at 6th level

sorcerer-16._why: PHB: fourth Metamagic option at 17th level
